title.zh: AstroAI Chain 进展审核公开摘要

status.en: Research and acceptance work in progress
status.zh: 研发与验收工作持续推进

scope.en: Nontechnical progress and assurance-stage information only.
scope.zh: 仅披露非技术进展与审核阶段。

items.en: The team continues engineering, validation and documentation work. Recent registered progress was checked against internal evidence.
items.zh: 团队持续推进工程、验证与文档工作；已依据内部证据复核近期登记的进展。

items.en: Targeted internal verification has progressed. Production readiness and independent review are assessed separately.
items.zh: 定向内部验证已有进展；生产就绪与独立审核另行评估。

items.en: Production acceptance remains incomplete. This update is not a mainnet-launch announcement, security certification or performance guarantee.
items.zh: 生产验收尚未完成；本更新不代表主网正式上线、安全认证或性能保证。

items.en: Protocols, architecture, implementation, deployment information and private review materials are not disclosed.
items.zh: 协议、架构、实现、部署信息与内部审核材料均不公开。
